title: Email service setup with Resend — transactional email templates
description: Set up Resend for sending transactional emails. Create reusable email templates for: password reset, milestone reminders, todo reminders.
acceptanceCriteria: Resend SDK installed and configured with RESEND_API_KEY
sendEmail(to, subject, html) utility function exists
Password reset email template renders correctly
Milestone reminder email template renders correctly
All emails include unsubscribe footer with link to update notification preferences
Test email sends successfully to a real address

steps.details: Create server/src/services/emailService.ts. Initialize Resend: const resend = new Resend(process.env.RESEND_API_KEY). Export async function sendEmail({ to, subject, html }): wrap resend.emails.send in try/catch, log errors but don't throw.

Create server/src/emails/passwordReset.ts exporting function passwordResetEmail(resetUrl: string): string — returns HTML string. Create milestoneReminder.ts: function milestoneReminderEmail(milestoneName, projectName, dueDate, settingsUrl): string. Include unsubscribe link: settingsUrl + '?tab=notifications'.
Set RESEND_API_KEY and FROM_EMAIL in .env. Call sendEmail with test address. Verify email arrives. Check Resend dashboard for delivery confirmation.

technicalNotes: Resend requires a verified domain in production — use onboarding@resend.dev for development
Always add an unsubscribe mechanism to comply with CAN-SPAM
